text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Lembah Klang Timur) 2025.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 30 Ogos 2025.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Lembah Klang Timur

yang bermula dari kilometer 0.00 di koordinat U -73360.788, T 34660.310

Geosentrik Datum Malaysia (GDM2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 16.78

di koordinat U -58391.875, T 33186.605 Geosentrik Datum Malaysia (GDM2000),

termasuk Persimpangan Bertingkat Sungai Long, Plaza Tol Sungai Long,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Bandar Mahkota Cheras, Plaza Tol Bandar Mahkota Cheras,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Hulu Langat, Plaza Tol Hulu Langat,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Ampang, Plaza Tol Ampang dan jalan sambungannya,

iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang 16.78 kilometer, diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

[Subperenggan 2(2)]

PETA LEBUH RAYA LEMBAH KLANG TIMUR

Dibuat 27 Ogos 2025

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Menteri Kerja Raya

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat menurut seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (EAST KLANG VALLEY EXPRESSWAY) ORDER 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Selangor,

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (East Klang Valley

Expressway) Order 2025.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 30 August 2025.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the East Klang Valley Expressway

commencing from kilometre 0.00 at coordinates N -73360.788, E 34660.310

of the Geocentric Datum of Malaysia (GDM2000) and ending at kilometre 16.78

at coordinate N -58391.875, E 33186.605 of the Geocentric Datum of Malaysia

(GDM2000), including the Sungai Long Interchange, Sungai Long Toll Plaza,

Bandar Mahkota Cheras Interchange, Bandar Mahkota Cheras Toll Plaza,

Hulu Langat Interchange, Hulu Langat Toll Plaza, Ampang Interchange,

Ampang Toll Plaza and its link roads, being a distance of 16.78 kilometre,

is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1)

is shown on the map in the Schedule.
